en.headline: High Court judge Wilson Chan to retire early after repeated plagiarism
en.dek: Chief Justice Andrew Cheung formally requested the early retirement, saying repeated judicial copying had undermined public confidence in the judge’s ability to discharge his duties.
body: Chief Justice Andrew Cheung Kui-nung has formally requested High Court judge Wilson Chan Ka-shun to take early retirement after finding that repeated instances of judicial plagiarism had undermined public confidence in the judge’s continued ability to perform his duties properly.

In a statement, the Chief Justice said he had requested the early retirement and had approved Mr Justice Chan’s application in the public interest. The retirement takes effect on 31 July 2026. Mr Justice Chan, who is 64, would otherwise have been eligible to serve until the normal retirement age of 70.

The Chief Justice noted that judicial copying had continued despite a previous severe reprimand and an undertaking to improve. He said such conduct adversely affected the interests of parties, imposed an unnecessary burden on appellate resources, and raised serious concerns about whether an independent judicial mind had been brought to bear on the issues. The Judiciary said it would strengthen training on judgment writing.

zh.headline: 高等法院法官陳嘉信因多次抄襲提早退休
zh.dek: 終審法院首席法官張舉能正式要求陳嘉信提早退休，指其多次在判詞中抄襲已損害公眾對他履行職務能力的信心。
body: 終審法院首席法官張舉能正式要求高等法院法官陳嘉信提早退休。張舉能表示，陳嘉信多次在判詞中出現司法抄襲，已損害公眾對他繼續妥善履行司法職責的信心。
張舉能在聲明中表示，已正式要求陳嘉信提早退休，並基於公眾利益批准其退休申請，退休於2026年7月31日生效。現年64歲的陳嘉信原本可服務至正常退休年齡70歲。
首席法官指出，儘管早前已發出嚴重譴責，而陳嘉信亦承諾改善，司法抄襲情況仍繼續出現。他表示，有關行為不但影響訴訟各方利益、加重上訴司法資源負擔，更令人嚴重關注法官是否以獨立思維處理案件。司法機構表示會加強判詞寫作培訓。
